question: Where was the International Shooting Sport Federation World Cup 2022 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cairo, Egypt**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) World Cup 2022** was held in **Cairo, Egypt**.
 
• This event is part of the **annual series** of competitions organized by the ISSF to provide a platform for shooters from around the world to compete.
 
• Cairo, the capital of Egypt, is known for hosting various international sporting events, leveraging its extensive facilities and organizational capabilities.
 
• The ISSF World Cup serves as a qualifying event for other major competitions, including the **Olympic Games**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Shooting Sport Federation** was founded in 1907 and is the governing body for the sport of shooting.
 
• It oversees the rules and regulations for various shooting disciplines, including rifle, pistol, and shotgun events.
 
• The ISSF World Cup series is held annually and includes multiple events across different countries, culminating in the ISSF World Cup Final.
 
• These competitions not only provide a platform for elite shooters but also help in the development of shooting sports globally.
 
• Hosting the ISSF World Cup is a prestigious event for any city and contributes to the promotion of sports tourism and international cooperation.
